🚀 Big Launches.title: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermark from its AI generations
🚀 Big Launches.summary: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermarks from AI-generated content, but invisible benchmarks will still be used to identify AI-generated files.

🚀 Big Launches.title: You can now turn off Google Gemini’s visible watermarks
🚀 Big Launches.summary: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermarks from the images, videos, and music made with AI tools.

🚀 Big Launches.title: Apple trained its own AI model for China with help from Alibaba
🚀 Big Launches.summary: Apple has reportedly trained a custom AI model for the China market alongside domestic tech giant Alibaba.

🛠️ Builder's Toolbox.title: Google Cloud AI Platform now supports custom machine learning models
🛠️ Builder's Toolbox.summary: Google Cloud AI Platform now supports custom machine learning models, allowing developers to train and deploy their own models.

🎯 Interview Edge.title: Kog is going deeper to squeeze more inference out of GPUs
🎯 Interview Edge.summary: Kog is working on a new approach to squeeze more inference out of GPUs, which could be relevant to agentic workflows.

🎯 Interview Edge.title: Dual-Flow Transformers: Decoupling the Primary Prefill Path from Additional Decode Computation
🎯 Interview Edge.summary: This paper proposes a new architecture for large language models that decouples the primary prefill path from additional decode computation.

⚖️ Responsible AI.title: Position: The Alignment Community is Unintentionally Building a Censor's Toolkit
⚖️ Responsible AI.summary: This position paper argues that modern AI alignment methods may be dual-use technologies that can be misused for censorship and manipulation.

⚖️ Responsible AI.title: Agreement Is Not Alignment: Divergent Moral Grounds in Human and LLM Ethical Judgments
⚖️ Responsible AI.summary: This paper argues that agreement with human judgments is not a reliable proxy for evaluating the alignment of large language models.

🔮 On the Horizon.title: LoKiFormer: Locality-aware Attention with Decoupled Knowledge Memory for Efficient Large Language Model Pretraining
🔮 On the Horizon.summary: This paper proposes a new architecture for large language models that incorporates locality-aware attention and decoupled knowledge memory.

🔮 On the Horizon.title: Which Site, and When: A Free-Satellite-Data Test of Himalayan Glacial Lake Bursts, Landslides, and Ice Floods
🔮 On the Horizon.summary: This paper uses free satellite data to test the feasibility of detecting glacial lake bursts, landslides, and ice floods in the Himalayas.
